name: Kakei Advisors
description: Kakei Advisors — a theme for an independent, fee-only financial planner, laid out in horizontal strips under a formal white top header (office name, tagline, a Book a first meeting button and a menu button); the menu opens as a full-screen pine-green overlay with large numbered entries at every width. Matsuba pine green (#42602D) is the main colour: the hero, the office band, every page head and the overlay are green fields in white type with a soft wash. The hero is a framed window: the title, lead, buttons and the questions of the month on the left, the meeting room seen through a white window frame with glazing bars on the right, and a cut-out olive tree (transparent WebP) standing over the frame's lower corner and breaking past the hero bottom edge; a cut-out green notebook breaks over the office band and every page head. The services run as ruled horizontal strips (number, photo, title, facts, line) and the life stages as one long sideways-scrolling strip. Every picture is a realistic 35mm film-grain photograph of a modern, international setting. Noto Serif JP for display, Inter for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Illustration only: the plan row says watercolour, and the 2026-10-18 image rule turns every new commercial theme to realistic photographs, so watercolour became the film-grain photo direction (35mm, 50mm f/2, natural side light, visible grain, slightly faded like a wash, graded toward matsuba green). full-illustration = every hero and content picture is a full photograph; a soft CSS wash sits on the green fields.
